name: Feedback Studio
author: Bastiaan Kortenbout
description: Your running Feedback Studio review sessions in the Omarchy bar: open-comment counts, what the coding agent is doing, a QR code to review from your phone, and one-click starts for a folder, a Markdown file, or the demo.

barWidget.description: Review sessions, open comments, agent activity, and a phone QR code for Feedback Studio.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the widget asks each running session for its comment counts while the panel is closed. The open panel refreshes every 2 seconds.

schema.label: Notify on new comments
schema.description: Send a desktop notification when a session receives a new comment, for example from your phone.

schema.label: Phone-ready sessions (--tunnel)
schema.description: Start sessions from this widget with --tunnel: a public HTTPS URL through a Cloudflare quick tunnel, so the phone QR code works on any network. Traffic then leaves your machine.

schema.label: Server command
schema.description: Command that runs Feedback Studio. Empty means `npx -y feedback-studio@1`. Point it at a clone to run a development version, e.g. `node ~/src/feedback-studio/plugins/feedback-studio/bin/feedback-studio.mjs`.

schema.label: Picker starts in
schema.description: Folder the "Open a folder or .md" picker opens in. Empty means your home folder.
